title: The leading constant in polynomial evaluation over algebraically closed fields
abstract: How many nonscalar multiplications are needed to evaluate a polynomial of degree at most n, when linear combinations are free? This note gives an upper bound of √n + O(√n/log n) over every algebraically closed field, matching the leading constant in the known lower bound. The construction combines short multiplication chains, interpolation modulo pairwise coprime polynomials, and an algebraic-geometric argument.
